description: Is delivery to a country (optionally a city, by a date, for a specific gift) feasible? Returns earliest/latest estimate and warnings (PO box, hotel, holiday window) with a suggested action.

city.description: Destination city (used for warnings only; never store addresses in chat).

date_needed.description: YYYY-MM-DD the gift must arrive by.

gift_id.description: Optional gift_id to use that gift's delivery window.

locale.description: Language of the conversation with the user (e.g. he-IL, fr-FR). Localizes content and messages; prices and availability are unaffected.

name: check_delivery

display_text.description: Human-readable one-line summary of the result

earliest.description: ISO date of the earliest estimated delivery

error.description: Present only when the call failed

latest.description: ISO date of the latest estimated delivery

locale.description: BCP-47 locale the texts are localized to

title: Check delivery feasibility
